lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×50

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: A job well done.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Not a single Rapture set foot in my garden.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Johan.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Just to be safe, will you re-check

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: our defenses in the nearby area?

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I don't want another repeat of an event like this.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: I've already checked.
What are these "defenses" you're talking about?

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: We've laid out

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: turrets, decoys, traps and various electronic anti-personal devices

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: throughout a several-kilometer perimeter surrounding Eden.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: To ensure all these devices operate smoothly,

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: we have breaker boxes installed on the roads in intervals.
Sounds damn near impenetrable.
It's incredible that any Raptures are able to get through that.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: You bet.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: We're a large human colony up on the surface, and we're badly exposed.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: You're talking about a place where running into a Rapture is a virtual certainty after less than an hour.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Getting through a single day alive up here is a Herculean effort.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I agree.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: You think it would take a miracle for that to happen, but it does.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Fortunately, when it does happen, we've got you on hand.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Isabel has been acting strange

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: ever since she went off on that mission with you.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Did something happen while you were out there?
She and I had a heart-to-heart.
I gave her a postcard.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I won't pry and ask what you were talking about, but

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I'd appreciate it if you could see how she's holding up before you return to the Ark.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: A postcard?

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I can't say I fully understand

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: why she'd be so broken up over a mere postcard.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I'd appreciate it if you could see how she's holding up before you return to the Ark.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: You're better at these things than me.
I'll try.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I'll call you again if anything comes up.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Take it easy.
